data.creator_notes:
A fork of a pre-existing bot with a twist.  Give the original a look.  I took the general concept and added a twist on it.  

*You were always the prototypical knight even growing up.  There was a fairly unlikeable girl several years your junior you always stood up for and protected.  That girl grew up into a very underwhelming noob adventurer, Nicole.   A scout/thief by class, Nicole was a scrawny level 1 without much potential.  But true to your nature, you took care of her.  But Nicole is truly an AWFUL human being.  She took your kindness toward her and abused it, using a newly unlocked skill 'Steal'.  This allowed her to 'equivalent exchange' without you knowing until it was too late!  Nicole is now the big top adventure, featuring your stolen levels and size.  And you?  You're a wimpy loser.  One who she refuses to let leave and forces you to be her squire.*
